This product is very good. I can feel the difference in my skin since I started using it. I bougth for second time already. It's a high price but I am OK since I feel the difference.

I worked in the beauty industry in my late teens therefore skin care has been a staple in my routine for the last 20+ years. I have used several products over the years to find one that truly improved my skin. THIS. IS. IT! My large pores, which nothing else touched, are barely there. The acne scar discoloration is completely gone. This is the first time in my life I have felt comfortable without full coverage foundation. My fine lines are truly non existent. It is worth every penny!

This is the worst serum I have purchased in the past 5 years. The vit-C serum never comes out of the pump no matter what I do. And there are threads on the internet talking about the same issue as I have and none of those suggestions solve the mystery. The "half-baked" serum is thick, not fast absorbed. while it might feel ok in the winter, I seriously doubt that this serum should be considered hot days. The combinatorial power of vit-c and ferulic acid is the reason why I purchased this serum but the vit -c is not coming out. what's the point then? What's even worse is I can't return it since the return window has gone.

Being in my mid-40s, I was looking for a serum that could tackle hydration, brightening my skin, and help get that youthful look back. I read a lot about this serum before trying, and it has not disappointed. It exceeded my expectations. My face's texture has improved and glows more than before! It has improved the look of my foundation as well. I added this to my daily routine a month ago. It absorbs perfectly and fast. I use it day and night. Absolutely love it! And smells wonderful. I have recently added Lancome's day cream to my routine from this line to try out. My previous skin care brand was lacking and this serum has been a game changer. Can't wait to see how the day cream works along this serum. Looking to add more of this line to my routine. My mom has always raved about Lancome's skin care for years and now I see why. Now I see why she doesn't look 70 😊!

avis.titre: WAY too thick and heavy for oily, combo and acne prone skin
avis.texte: Immediate breakout the next morning from my first overnight application. Large boil on my chin and clogged pores across my cheeks and forehead. It's going to take a week of blue light to help combat this breakout. When I say 'heavy' formula - visualize Vaseline "ointment" style heavy. Felt sticky and suffocating on my skin. I knew immediately this was going to be a breakout but was too tired to try to wash it off. I shouldn't have risked it. Also- the pump is garbage and had to pump and pump to try to get all three to dispense at once, and they weren't coming out consistently across the 3 formulas. Stick to a water based formula if you're acne prone, I think this has silicones. Absolutely suffocating, sticky and tacky. Felt exactly the same way in the morning. Never absorbed.

Initially I had issues with the pump dispensing all three serums properly but I decided to store it upside down and that has helped immensely! I love the way this makes my skin feel and look. It's extremely rare for me to find something that doesn't make my reactive skin very angry and this is one of those rare finds. I will definitely repurchase!

avis.titre: Made me break out all over
avis.texte: I have never in my life had acne like this serum has caused. After using a couple of days, I have multiple blemishes and red, rashy skin on 6 different areas of my face. Will absolutely be returning.

avis.titre: Glad I didn't pay full price
avis.texte: I purchased this half off during a sale. I can't say anything to the effectiveness of this product as I haven't used it for long or consistently.... and I don't plan to. This serum has a really strong "fresh" and slightly "floral" perfume scent that I definitely do not want on my face. It also has the texture of a sunscreen. It feels a little hydrating but the smell and overall feel are awful in my opinion. I'd much rather stick with a simple HA like from Good Molecules or The Ordinary.

I always look forward to her welcoming beautiful smile and warm personality. She is definitely knowledgeable about all the products and makes shopping at Ulta "ulta special".
This serum is SO nice! Even though it's pricey, definitely worth giving a try if you're considering it. I have pretty reactive, dry skin, and this product cooperated so well:)

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Renergie Triple Serum Retinol – A Skincare Saga I started using this magical potion expecting a gentle transformation. What I got was The Purge: Epidermis Edition. Week one, my skin decided it was time to evict every pore-clogging freeloader it had ever known. I looked like a hormonal tomato, but with purpose. By week two, I was glowing—sometimes from hydration, sometimes from sheer panic. The smell? Fancy. The texture? Silky, not oily—like a moisturizer that graduated summa cum laude. By week three, I was reborn. My skin was hydrated, smooth, and felt like it had just come back from a luxurious retreat in the Alps (but without the frostbite). I genuinely loved it, even if the purge part made me briefly question every life decision. 10/10 would survive the skincare apocalypse again.

I've been using the Lancôme Rénergie H.C.F. Triple Serum with Retinol for a few weeks now, and I have to say – I'm impressed. At first, I was a little unsure because my skin can be quite sensitive, and retinol sometimes causes irritation. But this formula feels very gentle. I love that it combines retinol, pure vitamin C, hyaluronic acid, and niacinamide in one product – it's like getting multiple benefits in one bottle. The texture is silky and lightweight, and it absorbs quickly without leaving any greasy feeling. I use it at night, and in the morning my skin feels smoother, more hydrated, and looks more even. I've also noticed my fine lines looking less visible, which is honestly amazing for such a short period. The packaging is very elegant and looks luxurious on my shelf. I also like the design of the pump – it keeps the ingredients fresh and delivers just the right amount of product. Overall, this serum has become a key part of my skincare routine. I definitely recommend it if you're looking for an anti-aging product that's effective but still gentle on the skin.

avis.titre: Was way thicker and heavier serum than pictured

Hyaluronic acid, Vitamin C, Niacinamide, Ferulic Acid... all the main ingredients typically come in semi-clear lightweight serums. But the bottle I received, one of the "serums" that it pumps out was such a heavy-duty thick/white moisturizer it completely overpowered whatever else was in it.. when applied, my skin was so greasy and disgusting I couldn't even cover up the oil with any amount of powder. I tried it for one day and now my skin is all broken out and I NEVER break out. I really wanted to like this. It may make your skin look 20 years younger, which would be fabulous and all, but I can't leave it on my skin long enough to reap the benefits (especially in Florida where you're a grease-ball all summer anyways). Certainly can't wear during the day. And I wouldn't even entertain wearing it overnight with how it clogged my skin all up and broke it out. I'm returning it ASAP.
